content.title: How to Watch Tigers vs Padres: Live Stream MLB Opening Day, TV Channel
content.text: Two-time reigning American League Cy Young winner Tarik Skubal gets the start on Thursday as the Detroit Tigers open against the San Diego Padres at Petco Park in San Diego.SAN DIEGO, CALIFORNIA - SEPTEMBER 27: Fernando Tatis Jr. #23 of the San Diego Padres reacts after hitting a solo homerun during the first inning of a ...How to Watch Tigers vs PadresDate: Thursday, March 26, 2026Time: 4:00 PM ETChannel: MLB Network, MLB.TVStream: Fubo (TRY FOR FREE)Skubal enters what could be his final season in Detroit, with free agency looming in the fall. He led the AL with a 2.21 ERA in 195.1 innings while striking out 241 batters to go with a major-league low 0.891 WHIP. The Tigers added left-hander Framber Valdez to the rotation in free agency and also brought back franchise icon Justin Verlander to be the fourth starter at age 43. Kenley Jansen joins the bullpen as a setup man for closer Kyle Finnegan, who re-signed with the club after coming over from the Washington Nationals. Meanwhile, 21-year-old Kevin McGonigle opens the season at shortstop after entering camp as the No. 2-ranked prospect in baseball.The Padres re-signed right-hander Michael King and brought in Korean infielder Sung-mun Song while also adding Nick Castellanos, released by the Philadelphia Phillies on the eve of spring training. Joe Musgrove, out all of last season after Tommy John surgery, starts the season on the injured list, as does right-hander Griffin Canning, still recovering from an Achilles’ tendon tear. But San Diego gets a full season of Mason Miller as the closer after allowing Robert Suarez to leave via free agency. Miller had a 0.77 ERA and 0.729 WHIP in 23.1 innings with 45 strikeouts after coming over from the Athletics at the trade deadline.
